label: Ollama models (unload only)
description: Unloads every model Ollama holds in GPU memory and leaves the server running. Works for Ollama run by hand, in a container or as a service.

spec.label: Ollama models
stop:
import json
import sys
import urllib.request

BASE = "http://127.0.0.1:11434"
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(BASE + "/api/ps", timeout=5) as reply:
        models = json.load(reply).get("models") or []
    for entry in models:
        name = entry.get("model") or entry.get("name")
        if not name:
            continue
        request = urllib.request.Request(
            BASE + "/api/generate",
            data=json.dumps({"model": name, "keep_alive": 0}).encode(),
            headers={"Content-Type": "application/json"},
            method="POST",
        )
        urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=30).read()
except Exception:
    pass
sys.exit(0)
